comparison.objective: Permute modules among buffer sockets, versus commission an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated keyed module extraction, relocation, and socket insertion versus setscrew tool use, collar tuning, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct socket permutation is title-implied; no body/specs, mapping, or insertion rubric is available. Candidate instead requires repeatable dynamic stopping and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Module rearrangement tests discrete placement and insertion, not continuous response-based mechanical adjustment.
